Relief shown pictorially. Map of Saxony, showing both topographical features including the Ore Mountains and mines indicated by numbers. Includes the title in a decorative cartouche to the upper left with vignettes showing putti and Cupid assisting Vulcan to smelt metal, a woman at her spinning wheel and miners, a landscape beyond. Includes a large vignette of mining works to the lower margin. Includes a vignette of scientific and cartographic instruments to the upper margin. Includes two scalebars to the upper right margin. Titled 'Mappa Geographica Circuli Metalliferi, a M. Seuttero.' in the Catalogue of Maps, Prints, Drawings, etc., forming the geographical and topographical collection attached to the Library of his late Majesty King George the third, etc., London, 1829. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
